summary: Your sixteenth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on coding agents, instructions files, prompts and reviews with a confidence number, start a review log, extend your glossary, test AGENTS.md on a fresh session, check your applications, tag week 16 and plan week 17.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Start the review log: one line per feature an agent builds
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example from your repository
Give a fresh agent session only AGENTS.md and see if it gets the project running
Count this week's applications and add two honest sentences about working with an agent
Run git tag week-16, then plan week 17 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 2 or 3 applications
Play the Coding Agents Mix-up game to the end and see your score
